title: EscalationNotice
description: Agent-initiated ethical concern escalation. Any authorized agent may raise an EscalationNotice without being the party executing the action (the Whistleblower mechanism). The requested_action determines the mandatory task state transition: quarantine -> QUARANTINED, pause_and_review -> APPROVAL_PENDING, escalate_to_human -> APPROVAL_PENDING with mandatory human approver. See AGP Profile §23.

raising_agent_id.description: Identity of the agent raising the concern. Does not have to be the executing agent.

raising_agent_role.description: Governance role of the raising agent. compliance_monitor escalations carry higher automatic weight.

evidence_refs.description: References to EvidenceBundles, AttestedContexts, or other artifacts supporting the concern

requested_action.description: The action the raising agent requests be taken on the task. quarantine is the strongest — it stops execution immediately and flags for integrity review.

resolution.description: Populated by the resolving authority after the escalation is reviewed
